label: Todoist Task
description: A task in a Todoist account, as the Todoist connector reads it through the Sync API. Its fields keep Todoist's own meanings, so `priority` is Todoist's integer and a promoted copy maps it to the core type's enum.

description.description: The task's description, absent when it has none.

project_id.description: The Todoist project the task is in.

section_id.description: The section within the project, when the task is in one.

parent_id.description: The parent task, when this one is a subtask.

priority.description: Todoist's priority, from 1 for none to 4 for urgent.

child_order.description: The task's order among its siblings.

completed.description: Whether the task is completed in Todoist.

url.description: The task in Todoist's web app.

comment_count.description: How many comments the task has.
